function.name: detect_beats_and_filter
function.description: Analyzes an audio file to detect beats and filters them based on confidence levels and timing. Returns a list of times in seconds, each representing the occurrence of a significant beat within the audio file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capture_percentage.description: Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile. Values range from 0 to 100 (inclusive).

confidence_window_size.description: Selects the highest confidence beat within a given time window in seconds (e.g., 0.5), to ensure distinct beats are chosen in that period. This is a float type value.

message.content:
I’d love to help you pull out the beats (and even the scenes) from your track!  
To get started I’ll need the audio file you’d like analyzed. Once I have that, I can run the beat‑detection routine with a 50 % capture threshold (i.e., keep only beats that are at least in the top 50 % confidence band) and a suitable confidence‑window size to avoid clustering multiple beats too close together.

Could you please upload or share the audio file you want processed? Once I have it, I’ll run the analysis and return the timestamps of the significant beats. If you also want scene segmentation (e.g., detecting changes in musical sections or lyrical verses), let me know and I’ll add that step as well.
